issues.claim: price_ranges.full_service_or_custom: "$280-$700/month plus $199-$3,000 one-time setup for a managed deployment"
issues.problem: Does not follow from the sourced offerings. The only sourced managed monthly prices in offerings are Goodcall $79/$129/$299, Vocenya $49-$499 and Sarah247 "from $350 + 35c/min"; none reaches $700, and the only sourced setup statement is Sarah247's "setup included" (Vocenya: none published). The $280 low end, the $700 high end and the whole $199-$3,000 setup band come from Voicewell, Rosie and the NJ Business AI $697/$2,997 figures, which have no offering entry and no URL anywhere in the file - the caveats themselves say those NJ figures were only seen in search summaries and their pages could not be opened.
issues.fix: Rebuild the band from sourced prices only, e.g. "$350-$499+/month for managed receptionist plans (Sarah247 from $350 + 35c/min of usage; Vocenya Pro $499 for 2,500 minutes), setup included or not published", and drop $199-$3,000 from the range or add a Voicewell offering entry with a working source_url.

issues.claim: implications_for_consultancy #2, #3 and #5 cite "$280-$380/month plus $199-$299 setup (Voicewell)", "$499-$697/month high" and "setup from $0-$2,997" / "$2,997 + $697/month NJ outlier"
issues.problem: Specific numbers presented as known market facts with no source in the file. Voicewell, Rosie and the $697/$2,997 NJ figure appear only in prose; there is no offering, source_url or retrieved page for them, and the caveats state the $697/$2,997 page could not be opened. This contradicts the file's own statement that unopenable NJ figures were "deliberately excluded from offerings" while still using them to anchor the recommended price.
issues.fix: Either add Voicewell (and any NJ provider) as a properly sourced offering with a URL that opens, or restate these implications using only the sourced anchors: Sarah247 from $350 + usage, Vocenya $249/$499, Goodcall $79-$299, no published setup fee except Sarah247's included setup. Then the recommended $1,500-$3,000 build can be labelled as a judgement call rather than an undercut of a specific sourced outlier.

issues.claim: buyer_complaints #3: "the headline per-minute rate omits telephony, model choice, prompt size and per-call minimums, so the same agent can cost 5-10x its advertised rate once prompts grow"
issues.problem: Overstated relative to the cited thread. Thread 3118 (June 2026) contains the $0.17 average and the 11c-40c reports but no "5-10x" figure and no statement about per-call minimums; the only documented multiple is ~5x, in thread 2441, and Retell states it bills per second with no per-call minimum (the sole minimum is 10 seconds when a Dynamic Opening Message is used, per thread 2720).
issues.fix: Restate as: headline rate is component-only, prompt size can multiply billed LLM duration (Retell support showed ~5x on a 229-second call, thread 2441), and cite the 10-second dynamic-greeting minimum instead of "per-call minimums".
